cases.question: Show me all active surrogates in Screening and list their current substage.
Which IP cases are in matching right now? Include the names and emails for both IPs.
cases.title: IP Cases Currently in Matching
cases.sql:
SELECT
    ipc.case_id AS `Case ID`,
    ipc.case_file_name AS `Case Name`,
    ipc.stage AS `Stage`,
    s.status AS `Status`,
    NULLIF(CONCAT_WS(' ', c1.first_name, c1.last_name), '') AS `IP 1 Name`,
    c1.email AS `IP 1 Email`,
    NULLIF(CONCAT_WS(' ', c2.first_name, c2.last_name), '') AS `IP 2 Name`,
    c2.email AS `IP 2 Email`
FROM ip_case ipc
LEFT JOIN status s
    ON ipc.status_id = s.status_id
LEFT JOIN family f
    ON ipc.family_id = f.family_id
LEFT JOIN contact c1
    ON f.ip_1_id = c1.contact_id
LEFT JOIN contact c2
    ON f.ip_2_id = c2.contact_id
WHERE ipc.stage = 'matching'
  AND ipc.active = 1
ORDER BY ipc.case_id ASC
assumptions: Identified cases 'in matching right now' as active intended-parent (IP) cases currently in the 'matching' workflow stage.
Retrieved primary and secondary intended parents from the family profile associated with each IP case.
Displayed secondary intended parent details as blank when a case only has a single intended parent.

Which contracts are still waiting on a signature?
Show me which intended parents have never logged into their portal.
cases.title: Intended Parents Who Have Never Logged In
cases.sql:
SELECT 
    u.user_id AS `User ID`,
    u.first_name AS `First Name`,
    u.last_name AS `Last Name`,
    u.email AS `Email`,
    u.created AS `Account Created`,
    CASE 
        WHEN u.active = 1 THEN 'Active' 
        ELSE 'Inactive' 
    END AS `Account Status`,
    CASE 
        WHEN u.confirmed_email = 1 THEN 'Yes' 
        ELSE 'No' 
    END AS `Email Confirmed`
FROM user u
WHERE u.user_type = 'IP'
  AND u.last_login IS NULL
ORDER BY u.created DESC
assumptions: Intended parents are identified by user accounts categorized as 'IP' (Intended Parent).
Users who have never logged in are determined by having no recorded last login date.
Both active and inactive accounts are included, with their active status and email confirmation status displayed.

cases.question: Which cases have active, incomplete campaigns right now?
How many open To Dos does each admin currently have assigned to them?
Which surrogates are still waiting on their profile to be approved?
cases.title: Surrogates Awaiting Profile Approval
cases.sql:
SELECT
    gc.case_id AS case_id,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(CONCAT(COALESCE(c.first_name, ''), ' ', COALESCE(c.last_name, ''))), ''), gc.case_file_name) AS surrogate_name,
    c.email AS email,
    c.phone_number AS phone_number,
    gc.stage AS stage,
    s.status AS status,
    NULLIF(TRIM(CONCAT(COALESCE(a.first_name, ''), ' ', COALESCE(a.last_name, ''))), '') AS assigned_admin,
    gc.created AS case_created_at
FROM gc_case gc
JOIN contact c ON gc.gc_id = c.contact_id
LEFT JOIN status s ON gc.status_id = s.status_id
LEFT JOIN admin a ON gc.assigned_admin = a.admin_id
WHERE gc.case_type = 'surrogate'
  AND c.gc_profile_approved IS NULL
  AND gc.active = 1
  AND gc.closed IS NULL
ORDER BY gc.created DESC
assumptions: Identified surrogates through case records marked with a case type of 'surrogate' linked to their contact profiles.
Interpreted 'waiting on profile approval' as contacts whose gestational carrier profile approval date has not been set (is empty/null).
Filtered to active, unclosed cases to reflect surrogates currently progressing through the workflow.
